catalogueReferences.heading: Model 1 The Gong Banjo, this model is beautifully made 7 string with a banjorine pot.
Model 3 Made around 1884 another beautiful banjo, it is strung now but the photographs do show fine detail.

Model 4 Giraffe Neck Banjo No strings at present but this beauty is designed to fit in a Serviceman’s kit bag. This model has a mute through an arm rest, it’s hinged preso on the right-hand side to engage the mute. 4 studs showing in the neck raises studs to turn it into a short scale Piccolo banjo, what a marvel.

Model 5 Fretless early model. Stringless at present early Taylor banjo from late 19th Century. Top quality timber used in manufacture with strengthened neck to stand up to the forces applied and so very very fine.
